stratagems.name: DAEMONIC FURY
stratagems.summary: A World Eaters unit 6" or closer gains Lance (and Twin-linked with Daemonic Rage)

stratagems.name: DAEMONIC RESISTANCE
stratagems.summary: Attacks against it get -1 to wound this phase

stratagems.name: DAEMONIC STRENGTH
stratagems.summary: +1 Damage: Eightbound against non-Monsters/Vehicles, Exalted against Monsters/Vehicles

stratagems.name: DAEMONTIDE
stratagems.summary: A Blood Legions unit 6" or closer gets models back (1 Mounted, D3 Beasts or D6 Infantry)

stratagems.name: DRAWN TO THE SLAUGHTER
stratagems.summary: Once per battle: a destroyed Jakhals unit returns whole into Strategic Reserves

stratagems.name: ENDLESS PURSUIT OF VIOLENCE
stratagems.summary: Wholly 6" or closer to a Transport: embarks

stratagems.name: FAIL NOT THE BLOOD GOD
stratagems.summary: Re-roll 1s to hit, or every hit near a friendly Monster or Titanic unit

stratagems.name: FOCUSED FEROCITY
stratagems.summary: +1 melee Attack

stratagems.name: FRENZIED RESILIENCE
stratagems.summary: -1 Damage to attacks allocated to it this phase

stratagems.name: FULL-THROTTLE ASSAULT
stratagems.summary: Units disembarking after its Normal move make an assault disembark

stratagems.name: FURY UNLEASHED
stratagems.summary: Shot at: embarked Berzerkers disembark and surge D6+2"

stratagems.name: GOADED TO FURY
stratagems.summary: Shot at: a D6" surge move

stratagems.name: HACK AND SLASH
stratagems.summary: Charged this turn: +1 AP in melee this phase

stratagems.name: HORRIFYING VIOLENCE
stratagems.summary: Engaged enemies test Battle-shock at -1

stratagems.name: IMMORTAL FURY
stratagems.summary: Slain before fighting: always fights back

stratagems.name: IN THE SHADOW OF BRASS IDOLS
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 6+, or 5+ near a friendly Monster or Titanic unit

stratagems.name: MURDER-CALL
stratagems.summary: Unengaged: back into Strategic Reserves

stratagems.name: PUNISH THE CRAVEN
stratagems.summary: Enemies Falling Back from it must escape desperately (-1 if Battle-shocked)

stratagems.name: RAPID MANIFESTATION
stratagems.summary: Deep Strikes 6" from enemies, then no charge

stratagems.name: SCORN THE WITCH
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds

stratagems.name: SKULLS FOR THE SKULL THRONE!
stratagems.summary: Destroyed a unit: roll for one more Blessing of Khorne this round

stratagems.name: SMASH THROUGH
stratagems.summary: Moves through terrain this phase

stratagems.name: SUMMONED BY SLAUGHTER
stratagems.summary: Bloodletters arrive wholly 9" or closer to a slain model, 6" from enemies

stratagems.name: TRAIL OF DESTRUCTION
stratagems.summary: Mobile

stratagems.name: UNRELENTING ADVANCE
stratagems.summary: Shot at: a 6" Normal move

stratagems.name: WARP STALKERS
stratagems.summary: Moves through non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemies this phase

stratagems.name: WRATH BEYOND REASON
stratagems.summary: -1 Damage to ranged attacks against it until the attacker is done
